title: Whispering-gallery modes and free spectral range of a silica microsphere (spherical multipoles, analytic)
description:
A silica microsphere (n = 1.45, radius 50 um) in vacuum: its fundamental (radial order 1) magnetic-family whispering-gallery modes at l = 300 and 301, from one eigenfrequency run of em_fdfd_sphere (multipole_orders 300, 301, multipole_family hr = TE-like: E tangential) on the (r, theta) half disc from the centre to 52 um (5 nm radial cells, 60 theta cells for the picture; ~10,400 radial unknowns per order: seconds on the cpu, where a 3D model of this sphere would be out of reach). The outer end is the exact outgoing condition; the radiation Q of these modes is far beyond double precision, so the table shows Q = inf.
Analytic (Lam, Leung and Young 1992, asymptotic in nu = l + 1/2; m = n): m k a = nu + 2^(-1/3) alpha_1 nu^(1/3) - m / sqrt(m^2 - 1) + (3 / 10) 2^(-2/3) alpha_1^2 nu^(-1/3) + O(nu^(-2/3)), alpha_1 = 2.338107 (first Airy zero; the coefficients 1.8557571 and 1.0331503 are those of the Bessel zero j_(nu,1)); the next term is ~2e-4 of the wavelength at nu ~ 300, the radial discretisation ~5e-5.
Derived values tab: lambda_300, lambda_301 (rows 0 and 1 of em.resonances) vs the asymptotic formula, and the free spectral range FSR = lambda_300 - lambda_301 (~4.75 nm) vs its difference (the neglected term varies slowly with l, so the FSR is tighter than each wavelength).
Field tab: the mode lies within a few um of the surface (|E_t| peak), with an evanescent tail outside.
